cancelGuidePage.subTitle: The system supports passengers to self-cancel tickets online quickly, safely and securely through the Email/Phone verification mechanism.
cancelGuidePage.step1Desc: Click the "Ticket Lookup" button on the navigation bar or directly access the ticket lookup page.
cancelGuidePage.step2Desc: Provide the Phone Number used to buy the ticket and the Order Code (e.g. #774588) sent in the booking confirmation email.
cancelGuidePage.step3Desc: If your ticket is eligible for online cancellation, the system will show the "Cancel & Refund" button. Click it to proceed.
cancelGuidePage.step4Desc: Enter your booking Email & Phone to verify security, agree to terms and select "Confirm Ticket Cancellation".
cancelGuidePage.rule1Time: 24 hours or more before departure time
cancelGuidePage.rule1Note: Passengers receive a full refund of the paid ticket amount.
cancelGuidePage.rule2Time: From 12 hours to less than 24 hours before departure time
cancelGuidePage.rule2Note: Passengers are refunded half the ticket price; the other half is charged as a cancellation fee.
cancelGuidePage.rule3Time: Less than 12 hours before departure time
cancelGuidePage.rule3Note: Online cancellation is not supported to avoid last-minute dummy seats.
cancelGuidePage.disclaimer1: * The above policy does not apply to holiday/peak period tickets or special promotional tickets (which follow separate rules specified at the time of purchase).
cancelGuidePage.disclaimer2: * Refunds will be automatically transferred back to the original bank account or e-wallet used for payment.
cancelGuidePage.warn1: Once cancelled on the system, tickets **cannot be restored** under any circumstances.
cancelGuidePage.warn2: Immediately after a successful cancellation, your old seat will be **automatically released back to empty** for other passengers to book.
cancelGuidePage.warn3: Refund rates and cancellation conditions are determined exactly by the **time you press the "Confirm Ticket Cancellation" button**, not the initial request submission time.
cancelGuidePage.warn4: In case of network interruption or failed refund transaction, please keep the Order Code and contact our Hotline immediately.
cancelGuidePage.ctaTitle: NEED TO CANCEL YOUR TICKET NOW?
cancelGuidePage.ctaDesc: If your departure time is at least 12 hours away, click below to go to the Lookup page and process the cancellation.
cancelGuidePage.faq1Q: After confirming the ticket cancellation, how long will it take to receive my refund?
cancelGuidePage.faq1A: The refund will be automatically transferred back to the bank account or e-wallet (MoMo, VNPAY) you used for payment within 3 to 5 business days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays) depending on the processing cycle of each bank.
cancelGuidePage.faq2Q: Why is my "Cancel & Refund" button not displayed or disabled?
cancelGuidePage.faq2A: The cancellation button is only displayed when the actual time is at least 12 hours away from the departure time. If the remaining time is less than 12 hours, the payment status is "Unpaid", or the ticket is already used (Completed), the button will be hidden and disabled.
cancelGuidePage.faq3Q: Can I change my ticket details (trip, time) instead of canceling?
cancelGuidePage.faq3A: Currently, the online system only supports Cancelling and Rebooking. If you need to change your trip or departure time without paying cancellation fees, please contact our Hotline 0565 655 360 at least 24 hours before departure for manual ticket assistance.
cancelGuidePage.faq4Q: If I entered the wrong email when booking, can I still cancel online?
cancelGuidePage.faq4A: The online cancellation process requires you to enter the exact email used during booking for security verification. If you entered a wrong email and cannot remember it or if the system matches incorrectly, please call our hotline 0565 655 360 for technical assistance to update email or process the refund.

newsPage.art1Title: ABC Bus Line Announces Next-Gen Smart AI Voice Booking Assistant
newsPage.art1Excerpt: ABC Bus officially integrates AI into the system, allowing customers to book tickets and select seats via Vietnamese voice commands incredibly fast.
newsPage.art1Content0: ABC Bus Line's intelligent AI Voice Booking technology marks a major breakthrough in the passenger transport industry in Vietnam. Now, instead of performing multiple steps on a phone, customers only need to speak their requests naturally.
newsPage.art1Content1: The AI Assistant will automatically analyze the departure, destination, and travel date to suggest the most suitable trip, while supporting seat selection in just 5 seconds. The system accurately recognizes Northern, Central, and Southern dialects.
newsPage.art1Content2: This is ABC Bus Line's continuous effort to provide the most modern and convenient travel experience, enabling even elderly customers to easily access online booking technology.
newsPage.art2Title: Secrets of Travelling to Da Lat Independently by Premium Limousine Cabin Bus
newsPage.art2Excerpt: Detailed guidebook on VIP cabin bus booking to Da Lat to see wild sunflowers, must-visit check-in points, and booking tips.
newsPage.art2Content0: Da Lat is always an attractive destination for tourists in all seasons of the year. To make the 300km journey from Ho Chi Minh City smooth and relaxing, ABC Bus Line's double cabin VIP Limousine is the optimal choice.
newsPage.art2Content1: The bus is equipped with spacious cabin beds featuring massage functions, charging ports, individual headphones, and private curtains. You can get a good night's sleep and wake up to the cool Da Lat morning breeze.
newsPage.art2Content2: The best time to visit Da Lat is from October to December when wild sunflowers bloom and pink grass hills are dreamy. Plan to book tickets 1-2 weeks in advance via ABC's website to get lower-deck cabins with wide glass views for pine forest sightseeing.
newsPage.art3Title: Super Promo: Flat 20% Off for Roundtrip Summer Bookings
newsPage.art3Excerpt: To show appreciation to customers and accompany the active tourist season, ABC Bus Line launches a major promo for roundtrip tickets on all routes.
newsPage.art3Content0: Summer is calling with white sand beaches in Nha Trang, Phan Thiet, Vung Tau, or cool air in Da Lat. To boost your trip energy, ABC Bus Line is pleased to introduce the 'Vibrant Summer - Complete Journey' promotion.
newsPage.art3Content1: Specifically, all roundtrip ticket purchases (Outbound & Return) made directly on the website or mobile app of ABC Bus Line will receive an instant 20% discount on the return ticket value.
newsPage.art3Content2: The program applies to bookings and departures from June 1, 2026, to August 31, 2026. The number of promotional tickets is limited daily, so book now to enjoy the best price with your family!
newsPage.art4Title: Announcement of Enhanced Trip Schedule for Big Holidays with Fixed Fare Guarantee
newsPage.art4Excerpt: To meet high travel demands, ABC Bus Line adds more than 100 trips per day and guarantees stabilized ticket fares.
newsPage.art4Content0: To satisfy the travel and holiday needs of passengers, ABC Bus Line has actively planned to increase trip frequency on all major key routes.
newsPage.art4Content1: We are adding 120 VIP Limousine trips daily departing from Hanoi, Da Nang, and Ho Chi Minh City. All extra buses are strictly inspected and cleaned before departure.
newsPage.art4Content2: Particularly, ABC Bus Line solemnly commits to the philosophy of 'Quality is Honor' - flat rate fares, absolutely no extra surcharges or price hikes during holidays, protecting customer rights.
newsPage.art5Title: Guide to Earning Points and Redeeming VIP Loyalty Rewards for Loyal Customers
newsPage.art5Excerpt: Discover the privileges of the Loyalty VIP program, automatic point accumulation after each trip, and easy steps to redeem discount vouchers.
newsPage.art5Content0: The ABC Bus Line Loyalty Program is designed to bring practical added values to each passenger's journey.
newsPage.art5Content1: After completing each trip, the system automatically accumulates reward points based on your ticket value (e.g., every 10,000 VND spent equals 1 Loyalty point). Achieving specific milestones will upgrade your tier: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond.
newsPage.art5Content2: Passengers can use these points to redeem vouchers of 50k, 100k VND, or premium souvenirs directly inside the ABC Bus Line app. Log in before booking so you do not miss any points!
newsPage.art6Title: Recruitment: Flight-Standard VIP Cabin Drivers and Attendants - High Income
newsPage.art6Excerpt: Expanding operations, ABC Bus Line is searching for professional partners to join the driver and cabin crew team.
newsPage.art6Content0: With the goal of upgrading highway passenger services to 5-star aviation standards, ABC Bus Line is expanding recruitment for high-quality positions nationwide.
newsPage.art6Content1: We look for Sleeper Bus Drivers (class E license, minimum 3 years of long-distance coach experience) and VIP Cabin Attendants (pleasant appearance, friendly communication, good problem-solving skills).
newsPage.art6Content2: Joining ABC Bus Line, you will work in a professional environment, with clear promotion paths, full insurance, and competitive market incomes (base salary + running performance bonuses).
